anambra.translation: [地名] [尼日利亚] 阿南布拉

anamirta cocculus wight et arnott.translation: [医] 印防己, 毒鱼防己

anamnesis.definition:
n the case history of a medical patient as recalled by the patient
n the ability to recall past occurrences
anamnesis.translation:
n. 回忆, 回想, 既往病历
[医] 记忆力, 既往症, 既往病史

anamnestic.definition: a. of or relating to anamnesis; aiding the memory
anamnestic.translation:
a. 记忆的, 回想的
[医] 记忆的, 既往症的

anamniotic.definition: a. Without, or not developing, an amnion.

anamorphic.definition:
a. pertaining to gradual evolution from one type of organism to another
a. pertaining to a kind of distorting optical system

anamorphic lens.translation: [计] 畸形镜头, 变形镜头

anamorphism.definition:
n the evolution of one type of organism from another by a long series of gradual changes
n metamorphism that occurs deep under the earth's surface; changes simple minerals into complex minerals
n a distorted projection or perspective; especially an image distorted in such a way that it becomes visible only when viewed in a special manner

anamorphoscope.translation: n. 歪像转正的曲面镜

anamorphose.translation: 图象变形, 图象失真

anamorphosis.definition:
n. the evolution of one type of organism from another by a long series of gradual changes
n. a distorted projection or perspective; especially an image distorted in such a way that it becomes visible only when viewed in a special manner
anamorphosis.translation:
n. 歪像, 失真图像, 畸形发育, 渐变体
[化] 变形; 失真

anamorphote.translation: 宽银幕透镜; 变形透镜
